summary: Frontend-only testing for Phase 10A Stage 3 WhatsApp Integration page (/whatsapp). Verified super_admin can access page with all 11 tabs, create account (POST /api/whatsapp/accounts), see masked API key, connection tab renders with status badge/buttons (Connect gracefully shows error toast when base_url empty, no crash), configuration tab shows Webhook URL and Verify Token with Salin buttons, Conversation Monitor renders two-panel empty state, all 4 AI sub-tabs (Agent/Knowledge/Style/Rules) save via PUT /api/whatsapp/ai-config with success toast, Human Handover empty state + Muat Ulang, WhatsApp Logs & API Logs render with Muat Ulang. RBAC verified: Sales and Accounting do NOT see the menu item and navigating to /whatsapp redirects them to /dashboard (page not rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: AccountsTab delete flow uses native window.confirm() which is not consistent with the rest of the app that uses shadcn Dialog/AlertDialog; consider using AlertDialog for a11y/UX consistency.
In AccountsTab openEdit, api_key is intentionally not prefilled (correct) but hmac_secret is also not preloaded — verify hmac update path works without wiping stored value when field left blank.
ConnectionTab/ConfigTab account selector chips would benefit from data-testid on all Salin (copy) buttons for automated testing.
